observation.command:
cd /workspace/02-backend
echo "=== services declaring psycopg2-binary vs psycopg (v3) ==="
grep -l "psycopg2-binary" */pyproject.toml | while read f; do echo "$(dirname $f): psycopg2-binary"; done
echo "--- any declaring psycopg[v3] ---"
grep -rl '"psycopg' */pyproject.toml | while read f; do echo "$(dirname $f): $(grep -oE '"psycopg[^"]*"' $f | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ')"; done
echo ""
echo "=== sqlalchemy versions resolved per lockfile ==="
for lf in */uv.lock; do v=$(grep -A2 'name = "sqlalchemy"' "$lf" | grep version | head -1 | awk '{print $3}'); echo "$(dirname $lf): sqlalchemy $v"; done | sort | uniq -c | awk '{print}' | sort -k4
